description: Convert text to NATO phonetic alphabet words (Alpha, Bravo…) and parse phonetic words back to text.

faqs.a: Letters A–Z, digits 0–9 (Zero, One, … Niner), spaces and common punctuation pass through unchanged.
Yes — decode matches each phonetic word case-insensitively (X-ray included). Unknown words are kept as-is in brackets.
faqs.q: Can I decode back to text?

faqs.a: The digits follow the official NATO set: Zero, One, Two, Tree, Fower, Fife, Six, Seven, Ait, Niner.

howto: Enter text in the input box.
Choose Encode (text → NATO words) or Decode (NATO words → text).
Press Convert to get the result.
Copy the output with one click.
title: NATO Phonetic Converter
